title: CR-Solver: GPU-Accelerated Kinematics Solver for Tendon-driven Continuum Robots
summary: Continuum robots provide intrinsic compliance, high dexterity, and safe physical interaction, enabling navigation and manipulation in confined and unstructured environments. Despite recent advances in sensing and control, heightening the need for precise motion generation, most widely used planning libraries are grounded in rigid-body assumptions, creating a critical gap for fast and practical tools for continuum robots. To address this, we present CR-Solver, a two-stage, optimization-based solver for the motion generation of tendon-driven continuum robots. Our method unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning within a single constrained nonlinear optimization framework. Leveraging GPU-accelerated parallel optimization, CR-Solver delivers fast, accurate, and constraint-aware solutions. We validate our approach on three tasks, demonstrating significant speedups over traditional CPU-based solvers while achieving a consistently high success rate above 95% and millimeter-level accuracy. The solver is implemented in pure Python, reducing the barrier to adoption and offering a practical, extensible foundation for continuum robots' high-performance motion planning.
tldr: CR-Solver is a GPU-accelerated, optimization-based kinematics solver for tendon-driven continuum robots that unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning in pure Python, achieving over 95% success rate and millimeter accuracy with significant speedups over CPU solvers.
tldr_zh: CR-Solver 是一个基于 GPU 加速的优化求解器，专为腱驱动连续体机器人设计，它将逆运动学、路径跟踪和轨迹规划统一在一个纯 Python 框架中，实现了超过 95% 的成功率和毫米级精度，相比传统 CPU 求解器大幅提升了速度。
summary_zh: 连续体机器人具有内在柔顺性、高灵巧性和安全的物理交互能力，能够在受限和非结构化环境中进行导航与操作。尽管近年来传感与控制技术取得了进展，日益需要精确的运动生成，但大多数广泛使用的规划库仍基于刚体假设，这为连续体机器人快速实用的工具开发造成了关键空白。为此，我们提出CR-Solver——一种基于优化的两阶段求解器，用于腱驱动连续体机器人的运动生成。该方法将逆运动学、路径跟踪和轨迹规划统一在单个约束非线性优化框架内。利用GPU加速的并行优化，CR-Solver能够提供快速、准确且满足约束的求解方案。我们在三项任务上验证了该方法，相比传统基于CPU的求解器实现了显著的加速，同时保持了始终高于95%的成功率和毫米级精度。该求解器采用纯Python实现，降低了应用门槛，为连续体机器人的高性能运动规划提供了一个实用且可扩展的基础。

title: X-GuideAR: An Augmented Reality Framework to Mitigate Radiation Exposure during Fluoroscopic Guidance
summary: Achieving optimal screw placement for orthopedic surgeries requires frequent alignment checks and multiple anatomical views under X-ray -- a process known as "fluoro-hunting" that increases radiation exposure to patients and surgical teams. This work introduces X-GuideAR, an augmented reality (AR) framework for identifying optimal X-ray views, aimed at reducing radiation exposure while ensuring accurate screw placement. To exemplify the benefits of X-GuideAR, we focus on S2 alar-iliac (S2AI) screw placement. Our system provides radiation-free guidance for view acquisition and drilling by generating synthetic X-ray previews that accelerate fluoro-hunting. Once the required anatomical views are identified using these previews, a real X-ray is acquired, and the preview of the drilling trajectory is augmented onto it, facilitating precise screw placement with minimal additional radiation. A preliminary study involving eight S2AI trajectories performed by an expert spine surgeon demonstrated a 62.3% reduction in the number of X-rays. Post-procedure evaluations showed that trajectories done with X-GuideAR supported an average safe screw diameter of 12.95 mm compared to 5.9 mm under the conventional workflow, suggesting improved bony containment and potential biomechanical benefit. X-GuideAR shows great potential to reduce radiation exposure and streamline S2AI screw placement, offering a promising direction toward safer and more efficient surgeries.
tldr: X-GuideAR uses augmented reality to generate synthetic X-ray previews for S2AI screw placement, reducing radiation exposure by 62.3% while improving screw containment accuracy.
tldr_zh: X-GuideAR利用增强现实生成合成X射线预览，用于S2AI螺钉置入，将辐射暴露减少62.3%，同时提高螺钉的骨内包容精度。
summary_zh: 摘要：骨科手术中实现最佳螺钉置入需要频繁的对齐检查和多角度X射线解剖视图——这一过程被称为“透视搜索”，会增加患者和手术团队的辐射暴露。本文介绍了一种名为X-GuideAR的增强现实（AR）框架，用于识别最佳X射线视图，旨在减少辐射暴露的同时确保精确的螺钉置入。为展示X-GuideAR的优势，我们聚焦于S2骶翼-髂骨（S2AI）螺钉置入。该系统通过生成合成X射线预览来加速透视搜索，从而为视图获取和钻孔提供无辐射引导。一旦利用这些预览确定了所需的解剖视图，便会采集真实X射线图像，并将钻孔轨迹的预览叠加到图像上，从而以最少的额外辐射实现精确螺钉置入。一项由一名资深脊柱外科医生实施8个S2AI轨迹的初步研究表明，X射线数量减少了62.3%。术后评估显示，使用X-GuideAR完成的轨迹支持的平均安全螺钉直径为12.95毫米，而传统工作流程下为5.9毫米，表明骨包容性改善并具有潜在的生物力学优势。X-GuideAR在减少辐射暴露和简化S2AI螺钉置入方面展现出巨大潜力，为实现更安全、更高效的手术提供了有前景的方向。

title: Feature-Space Guided Diffusion for Realistic Ultrasound Image Synthesis
summary: Conditional diffusion models can generate anatomically plausible medical ultrasound (US) images, but anatomical plausibility alone does not ensure realistic B-mode appearance. Most US pipelines adapt standard generative architectures and condition them on anatomical masks, or use guidance mechanisms that reinforce the same anatomical signal. However, B-mode US images are shaped by acquisition-dependent properties such as speckle texture, tissue contrast, and attenuation. Using a frozen US foundation model, we show that standard conditional diffusion baselines remain separated from real images in representation space. In this work, we propose Feature-Space Candidate Guidance (FSCG), a training-free sampling strategy to reduce this gap. At sampling time, FSCG applies local k-NN feature correction and selects the best of multiple stochastic candidates according to their feature-space energy. In this way, the mask defines the anatomy, while FSCG steers samples toward the real US domain. Across three different datasets, FSCG reduces average FID64 by 56\%, FID192 by 57\%, and nearest-neighbour feature distance by 47\% over standard conditional diffusion sampling, outperforming alternative inference-time guidance baselines. The results suggest that domain-aware feature representations can reveal and reduce realism gaps in medical diffusion synthesis without retraining the generator. Our code is available at https://github.com/marinadominguez/FSCG.
tldr: This paper introduces Feature-Space Candidate Guidance (FSCG), a training-free sampling strategy that uses a frozen ultrasound foundation model to reduce the realism gap between generated and real ultrasound images, achieving significant improvements in FID and feature distance across three datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了特征空间候选引导（FSCG），一种无需重新训练的采样策略，利用冻结的超声基础模型缩小生成图像与真实超声图像之间的真实感差距，在三个数据集上显著降低了FID和特征距离。
summary_zh: 条件扩散模型能够生成解剖学上合理的医学超声图像，但仅解剖合理性不足以保证真实的B型超声表现。大多数超声生成流程采用标准生成架构，并以解剖掩膜为条件，或使用强化相同解剖信号的引导机制。然而，B型超声图像受到采集相关特性的影响，如散斑纹理、组织对比度和衰减。利用冻结的超声基础模型，我们表明标准条件扩散基线在表征空间中仍与实际图像存在距离。本研究提出特征空间候选引导（FSCG），这是一种无需训练的采样策略，旨在缩小这一差距。在采样时，FSCG应用局部k近邻特征校正，并根据特征空间能量从多个随机候选中选出最优者。如此，掩膜定义了解剖结构，而FSCG将样本引导至真实的超声域。在三个不同数据集上，与标准条件扩散采样相比，FSCG使平均FID64降低56%，FID192降低57%，最近邻特征距离降低47%，表现优于其他推理时引导基线。结果表明，领域感知的特征表示能够揭示并减少医学扩散合成中的真实感差距，而无需重新训练生成器。我们的代码见https://github.com/marinadominguez/FSCG。

title: Multi-Catheter Digitization in Brachytherapy via Few-Shot Synthetic-to-Real Learning and Structure-Aware Tracking
summary: Accurate catheter digitization in CT-guided interstitial brachytherapy is a critical but time-consuming task, especially for complex implant configurations. We developed a data-efficient, physics-guided framework for automated multi-catheter digitization with minimal clinical annotation. The pipeline consists of two stages. First, an implant region-aware network was pretrained on synthetic CT volumes with simulated metallic signatures and then fine-tuned using only 10 clinical cases. Second, a structure-aware reconstruction module combined a direction-constrained 3D Hough transform with synchronous physics-constrained inward tracking to separate adherent catheter trajectories. The method was evaluated by patient-level five-fold cross-validation on 203 treatment fractions from 38 patients. The fine-tuned network achieved an HD95 of 0.853 +/- 0.362 mm. End-to-end evaluation yielded an F1 score of 0.891 +/- 0.178, with shaft and tip errors of 0.334 +/- 0.367 mm and 0.896 +/- 0.680 mm, respectively. In cases with severe catheter adhesion, the tracking F1 score remained 0.843 +/- 0.190. The complete workflow required approximately 11.6 s per case. These results indicate that combining few-shot synthetic-to-real learning with physics-guided structural tracking can provide robust and efficient multi-catheter digitization for time-sensitive clinical workflows.
tldr: A two-stage framework for automated multi-catheter digitization in CT-guided brachytherapy, using few-shot synthetic-to-real learning (pretrained on synthetic CT, fine-tuned on 10 clinical cases) and physics-constrained tracking to separate adherent catheters, achieving high accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 一种用于CT引导下插植近距离治疗中多导管自动数字化的两阶段框架，采用少样本合成到真实学习（在合成CT上预训练，在10例临床病例上微调）和物理约束跟踪来分离粘连导管，实现了高精度和高效率。
summary_zh: 在CT引导下的组织间近距离治疗中，准确的导管数字化是一项关键但耗时的任务，尤其对于复杂植入构型。我们开发了一种数据高效、物理引导的框架，用于在最少临床标注下实现自动化多导管数字化。该流程包含两个阶段：首先，一个植入区域感知网络在带有模拟金属伪影特征的合成CT体积上预训练，然后仅使用10个临床病例进行微调。其次，一个结构感知重建模块将方向约束的三维霍夫变换与同步物理约束的内向追踪相结合，以分离粘连的导管轨迹。该方法通过来自38名患者的203个治疗分次进行患者级五折交叉验证评估。微调网络的HD95达到0.853±0.362 mm。端到端评估的F1分数为0.891±0.178，导管体和尖端误差分别为0.334±0.367 mm和0.896±0.680 mm。在导管严重粘连的情况下，追踪F1分数仍保持在0.843±0.190。完整工作流程每例耗时约11.6秒。这些结果表明，将小样本合成到真实学习与物理引导的结构追踪相结合，能够为时间敏感的临床工作流程提供稳健高效的多导管数字化。

title: A Compact Top-Loading Robot for Endovascular Interventions: Design, Control and Evaluation
summary: Robot-assisted endovascular intervention can potentially reduce radiation exposure, improve surgeon ergonomics, enable telesurgery, support active assistance and autonomy, and enhance procedural precision. However, existing systems often suffer from limited procedural coverage because constrained patient-side setups, restricted flexibility, and complex instrument exchange hinder clinical workflow integration. This work presents a compact robotic system for endovascular interventions that enables continuous translational and rotational manipulation of standard endovascular instruments. The system consists of two alternating carts with pneumatically actuated membrane grippers integrated into rotating gripper gears. Its top-loading design allows rapid exchange of instruments such as guidewires and catheters without changing the robotic setup. A leader-follower control strategy enables continuous motion despite the finite stroke of each cart. The system was evaluated in motion-tracking experiments with guidewires and catheters and in an in vitro vascular phantom. The motion-tracking experiments showed generally smooth translational and rotational motion profiles. Across all tested guidewire and catheter experiments, the mean relative tracking errors were 3.6% for translational motion and 4.1% for rotational motion. In the vascular phantom, robot-assisted navigation reached the target in most trials, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed manipulation concept under in vitro conditions. The presented robotic system demonstrates technical feasibility for continuous manipulation of standard endovascular instruments in bench-top and in vitro experiments. The compact top-loading design may ease instrument exchange and clinical workflow integration. Future work will focus on improving gripping performance, actuation speed, force feedback, and evaluation in more clinically realistic settings.
tldr: This paper presents a compact top-loading robotic system for endovascular interventions that uses two alternating carts with pneumatic grippers for continuous instrument manipulation, and evaluates it in motion-tracking and in vitro phantom experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种紧凑型顶部装载式血管介入机器人系统，利用两个交替推车和气动夹持器实现连续器械操作，并在运动追踪和体外模型实验中进行了评估。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
机器人辅助血管内介入治疗有望减少辐射暴露、改善外科医生人体工学、实现远程手术、提供主动辅助与自主功能，并提升操作精度。然而，现有系统常因患者端布局受限、灵活性不足以及器械交换复杂而难以覆盖全部手术流程，阻碍了临床工作流的整合。本文提出了一种用于血管内介入治疗的紧凑型机器人系统，能够实现对标准血管内器械的连续平移与旋转操作。该系统由两个交替移动的推车组成，集成有气动膜片夹具，并安装于旋转夹具齿轮上。其顶部装载设计允许快速更换导丝、导管等器械，无需调整机器人设置。通过主从控制策略，即便每个推车行程有限，仍能实现连续运动。该系统在导丝与导管的运动跟踪实验以及体外血管模型上进行了评估。运动跟踪实验显示出总体平滑的平移与旋转运动曲线。在所有测试的导丝与导管实验中，平移运动的平均相对跟踪误差为3.6%，旋转运动为4.1%。在血管模型中，机器人辅助导航在多数试验中成功到达目标，验证了所提出的操控概念在体外条件下的可行性。本机器人系统在台架与体外实验中展现了操控标准血管内器械进行连续运动的技术可行性。其紧凑的顶部装载设计可能有助于简化器械交换与临床工作流整合。未来工作将聚焦于改进抓取性能、驱动速度、力反馈，并在更接近临床实际的环境中进行评估。

title: NVAITC AI Scientist: A Governed End-to-End Research System -- A Hypertension GWAS Case Study
summary: Agentic research systems are emerging as a new paradigm for coordinating scientific workflows beyond isolated model inference, code generation, or statistical analysis. However, deployment in institutional biomedical environments requires governed mechanisms for research planning, data access, workflow orchestration, evidence tracking, reproducibility, and human oversight. We present NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS), a governed end-to-end agentic research system designed to support domain-general scientific workflows while keeping protected data within institutional privacy boundaries. NAIS integrates proposal review, execution planning, governed computational routing, reproducible workflow orchestration, evidence generation, and scientist-in-the-loop oversight. We validate NAIS in a real-world hypertension genome-wide association study (GWAS) using hospital-linked genotype and electronic health record (EHR) data from 286,422 individuals under an aggregate-only data policy. The agent planned cohort extraction, orchestrated GWAS execution, generated quality-control summaries, and drafted publication-oriented outputs. Human-AI review identified phenotype discrepancies and enabled iterative refinement of the hypertension definition. After reconciliation, the agent-orchestrated GWAS reproduced established hypertension loci, including FGF5, ATP2B1, CNNM2, FTO, and GRB14, with the strongest signal at FGF5 reaching $-\log_{10}(p) \sim 70$. As a secondary demonstration, NAIS also supported a drug-induced liver injury prediction workflow, achieving a multimodal graph neural network AUC of 0.842. These results demonstrate that governed agentic research systems can support scalable AI-assisted biomedical discovery while producing outputs comparable to expert-led workflows.
tldr: This paper presents NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS), a governed end-to-end agentic research system that coordinates scientific workflows (proposal review, execution, evidence tracking) with human oversight, demonstrated on a hypertension GWAS using hospital data and a drug-induced liver injury prediction task.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS)，一个受管控的端到端代理研究系统，可协调科学工作流（提案审核、执行、证据追踪）并加入人类监督，通过高血压GWAS（利用医院数据）和药物性肝损伤预测任务进行了验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自主研究系统正作为一种新范式出现，用于协调超越孤立模型推理、代码生成或统计分析的科学工作流程。然而，在机构生物医学环境中部署此类系统需要具备受治理的机制，以支持研究规划、数据访问、工作流编排、证据追踪、可重复性及人工监督。我们提出NVAITC AI科学家（NAIS），这是一个受治理的端到端自主研究系统，旨在支持通用科学工作流，同时将受保护数据保留在机构隐私边界内。NAIS集成了提案评审、执行规划、受治理的计算路由、可重复工作流编排、证据生成以及科学家参与式监督。我们在一个真实的高血压全基因组关联分析（GWAS）中验证了NAIS，该分析使用了与医院关联的基因型及电子健康记录（EHR）数据，涵盖286,422名个体，并遵循仅聚合数据政策。该自主系统规划了队列提取、编排GWAS执行、生成质量控制摘要，并起草了面向发表的结果。人机联合评审识别了表型不一致之处，并实现了对高血压定义的迭代优化。经调和后，自主系统编排的GWAS复现了已知的高血压相关基因座，包括FGF5、ATP2B1、CNNM2、FTO和GRB14，其中FGF5的最强信号达到$-\log_{10}(p) \sim 70$。作为二次展示，NAIS还支持了一项药物性肝损伤预测工作流，实现了多模态图神经网络AUC为0.842。这些结果表明，受治理的自主研究系统能够支持可扩展的AI辅助生物医学发现，同时产出与专家主导工作流相当的结果。

title: FlowPET: Physics-Informed Symplectic Flow Matching for Low-Count PET Reconstruction
summary: Low-count Positron Emission Tomography (PET) reconstruction is severely hindered by the dissipative nature of prevailing generative models, where the inherent phase-space contraction leads to the numerical extinction (``wash-out'') of weak but diagnostically critical lesion signals. To overcome this geometric limitation, we propose \textbf{FlowPET}, a physics-informed framework that reformulates reconstruction as volume-preserving transport in a symplectic phase space. By parameterizing the posterior dynamics via a Separable Hamiltonian System, our approach guarantees a divergence-free vector field by construction, theoretically immunizing weak signals against probability mass collapse. To steer this conservative flow, we introduce conjugate boundary conditions based on the Range-Null space decomposition of the PET operator; this strictly enforces data consistency in the range space while confining stochastic uncertainty injection to the unobserved null space. We train the model via symplectic flow matching and perform inference using a symplectic leapfrog integrator. Extensive experiments on BrainWeb, clinical pediatric, and UDPET datasets demonstrate that \textbf{FlowPET} not only surpasses state-of-the-art deterministic and stochastic baselines in SSIM and PSNR but, more crucially, exhibits superior recovery of low-contrast lesions. The results confirm that imposing Hamiltonian structural constraints offers a robust geometric safeguard for medical inverse problems in high-noise regimes.
tldr: FlowPET proposes a physics-informed symplectic flow matching framework for low-count PET reconstruction that enforces volume-preserving transport via Hamiltonian dynamics, preventing loss of weak lesion signals and achieving superior reconstruction quality.
tldr_zh: FlowPET 提出了一种基于物理信息的辛流形匹配框架用于低计数 PET 重建，通过哈密顿动力学保证体积守恒传输，防止弱病变信号丢失，并实现了更优的重建质量。
summary_zh: 低计数正电子发射断层扫描（PET）重建受到当前主流生成模型耗散特性的严重制约，其固有的相空间收缩导致微弱但具有诊断关键意义的病灶信号出现数值性消失（“冲刷”）。为克服这一几何局限性，我们提出**FlowPET**——一种基于物理信息的框架，将重建问题重新表述为辛相空间中的体积保持输运。通过利用可分离哈密顿系统对后验动力学进行参数化，我们的方法从构造上保证了无散向量场，理论上使弱信号免受概率质量坍缩的影响。为引导这一保守流，我们基于PET算子的值域-零空间分解引入共轭边界条件；这在值空间内严格强制数据一致性，同时将随机不确定性注入限制在未观测的零空间中。我们通过辛流匹配训练模型，并利用辛跳点积分器进行推理。在BrainWeb、临床儿科及UDPET数据集上的大量实验表明，**FlowPET**不仅在SSIM和PSNR上超越了最先进的确定性和随机基线方法，更重要的是，它在低对比度病灶的恢复上展现出卓越性能。结果证明，施加哈密顿结构约束为高噪声环境下的医学逆问题提供了稳健的几何保障。

title: LaGuadia: Language-Guided Adaptive Distillation from Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology Foundation Models (PFMs) offer powerful Whole Slide Image (WSI) representations but suffer from massive computational costs. While Knowledge Distillation (KD) can create efficient student models, existing multi-teacher methods often use suboptimal uniform weighting that ignores tissue heterogeneity. We propose LaGuadia (Language-Guided Adaptive DistillAtion), a framework that develops a compact pathology image encoder by dynamically integrating expertise from multiple PFMs under clinical linguistic guidance. Our approach utilizes a multi-stage pipeline: first, extracting visually observable clinical keywords from pathology reports; second, aligning visual features with these keywords via a Vision-Language meta-teacher (MedSigLIP) to provide dense semantic guidance; and finally, performing adaptive KD where teacher contributions are weighted based on their semantic alignment with the clinical narrative. Experiments on WSI captioning, visual question answering, and slide-level classification tasks demonstrate that an 87M parameter LaGuadia student model matches or exceeds foundation-scale models such as GigaPath and UNI, achieving strong factual consistency and robust generalization. These results highlight clinical language as an effective semantic anchor for building efficient and reliable digital pathology systems. Code is available at https://github.com/hvcl/LaGuadia.
tldr: LaGuadia uses language-guided adaptive knowledge distillation to create a compact pathology image encoder that matches large foundation models, leveraging clinical keywords and vision-language alignment for efficient WSI analysis.
tldr_zh: LaGuadia 利用语言引导的自适应知识蒸馏，创建了一个紧凑的病理图像编码器，其性能可与大型基础模型媲美，通过临床关键词和视觉-语言对齐实现高效的WSI分析。
summary_zh: 病理基础模型（PFMs）提供了强大的全切片图像（WSI）表示，但面临巨大的计算成本。虽然知识蒸馏（KD）可以创建高效的学生模型，但现有的多教师方法通常使用次优的均匀加权，忽略了组织异质性。我们提出LaGuadia（语言引导的自适应蒸馏），一个通过动态整合多个病理基础模型在临床语言指导下的专业知识来开发紧凑的病理图像编码器的框架。我们的方法采用多阶段流水线：首先，从病理报告中提取视觉上可观察的临床关键词；其次，通过视觉-语言元教师（MedSigLIP）将视觉特征与这些关键词对齐，以提供密集的语义指导；最后，执行自适应蒸馏，其中教师贡献基于它们与临床叙述的语义对齐程度进行加权。在全切片图像字幕生成、视觉问答和切片级分类任务上的实验表明，一个87M参数的LaGuadia学生模型匹配或超越了基础规模的模型如GigaPath和UNI，实现了强事实一致性和稳健的泛化能力。这些结果突显了临床语言作为构建高效可靠数字病理系统的有效语义锚点。代码可在 https://github.com/hvcl/LaGuadia 获取。

title: Vectorial driving of multistable materials: singularities, pt-graphs, and non-generic paths
summary: Describing and predicting the response of multistable materials to external driving is central to memory formation, programmable metamaterials, soft robotics, and in-materia computing. While scalar driving is captured by transition graphs (t-graphs), vectorial driving produces path-dependent responses that require the recently introduced path-transition graphs (pt-graphs). In both cases, transitions are governed by singularities in the energy landscape: for scalar driving these correspond to saddle-node bifurcations, but for vectorial driving, higher-order singularities become important. Combining experiments on chain-like metamaterials with a minimal spring model, we investigate how higher-order singularities shape pt-graphs and the resulting path-dependent responses. We moreover discuss the role of non-generic driving paths through higher-order singularities, where the response is governed by spontaneous symmetry breaking. Finally, we demonstrate how t-graphs emerge as the one-dimensional limit of pt-graphs, unifying scalar and vectorial driving within a common graph-based framework. These results establish a singularity-based approach to path-dependent responses and provide a foundation for designing multistable materials with programmable sequential functionality for smart sensing, soft robotics, and in-materia computation.
tldr: This paper extends the concept of transition graphs for scalar driving to path-transition graphs (pt-graphs) for vectorial driving of multistable materials, revealing how higher-order singularities govern path-dependent responses and unifying both frameworks.
tldr_zh: 本文将为标量驱动开发的转移图（t-graphs）概念扩展到多稳态材料的矢量驱动，引入了路径-转移图（pt-graphs），揭示了高阶奇点如何控制路径依赖响应，并统一了两种框架。
summary_zh: 描述和预测多稳态材料对外部驱动的响应是记忆形成、可编程超材料、软体机器人以及材料内计算的核心问题。标量驱动可通过跃迁图（t-graphs）进行描述，而矢量驱动则会产生路径依赖的响应，需要用到近期提出的路径跃迁图（pt-graphs）。在这两种情况下，跃迁由能量景观中的奇点控制：对于标量驱动，这些奇点对应于鞍结分岔；但对于矢量驱动，高阶奇点变得重要。通过将链状超材料的实验与最小弹簧模型相结合，我们研究了高阶奇点如何塑造pt-graphs以及由此产生的路径依赖响应。此外，我们讨论了通过高阶奇点的非通用驱动路径的作用，此时响应由自发对称破缺控制。最后，我们展示了t-graphs如何作为pt-graphs的一维极限涌现，从而在统一的基于图的框架下统一标量驱动和矢量驱动。这些结果建立了一种基于奇点的路径依赖响应方法，并为设计具有可编程顺序功能的多稳态材料提供了基础，这些材料可用于智能传感、软体机器人和材料内计算。
